description: Still searching for a route home, the expedition encounters visitors from other times, hidden societies and increasingly supernatural threats while the disappearance of Summerlee and the possibility of escape continue to haunt the group.

s02e01.description: The survivors of the bridge disaster search for one another and confront the apparent loss of Summerlee. Their reunion comes with a debt to Tribune, who leads them toward a fishing village ruled by a local tyrant and another fight they did not schedule.

s02e02.description: Roxton, Malone and Challenger are rescued by an Amazon tribe after an attack, only to learn that the men's welcome has a very specific purpose. The tribe's breeding ritual becomes less appealing once they discover what traditionally happens to the participants afterward.

s02e03.description: A lightning experiment opens a passage from the modern world and drops a group of tourists onto the plateau with a damaged aircraft. The explorers must rescue the newcomers while Challenger wonders whether the accident might also provide a route home.

s02e04.description: A storm drives Roxton, Marguerite and Malone into an isolated castle where clothes, rooms and old memories begin imposing new personalities on them. Soon the trio are reenacting a murderous romantic triangle belonging to people long dead.

s02e05.description: A riderless horse carries Roxton to a mountain people who identify him as their rightful king. Accepting the crown means confronting both a scheming adviser and the tribe's tradition of sacrificing victims to a very real dragon.

s02e06.description: Marguerite's sudden serenity is the first clue that something else is using her body. Alien invaders capable of occupying humans and animals force the group to determine who is still themselves before the visitors acquire more useful hosts.

s02e07.description: An old map appears to reveal a route off the plateau, and Challenger and Malone begin preparing evidence for the skeptical world waiting outside. Malone seems to reach London and his old life, but the apparent homecoming raises uncomfortable questions about what he now considers home.

s02e08.description: A shape-shifting woman tells Veronica that her missing parents are safe in El Dorado and gives her directions to a hidden entrance. Following the promise instead releases a powerful prisoner, leaving the expedition to put back something that was imprisoned for good reason.

s02e09.description: Tribune seeks sanctuary at the Treehouse from the Lizardmen and draws Malone, Marguerite and Roxton into captivity with him. Their captors turn Roxton and Tribune into gladiators while Malone must use Challenger's reputation to keep everyone alive.

s02e10.description: A severe drought leads the explorers to a woman whose survival depends on returning to a hidden Fountain of Youth. Marguerite needs very little persuasion to join the search, though eternal youth on the plateau naturally comes with less pleasant conditions than advertised.

s02e11.description: Trophy hunters arrive claiming they can take the Challenger expedition home, but Veronica has already seen them hunting intelligent creatures for sport. The offer of rescue forces the group to decide whether the newcomers are saviors or simply collectors looking for rarer specimens.

s02e12.description: A mysterious woman named Danielle charms Roxton and claims her village was overrun by Trogs. Her story conceals a talent for voodoo and control over an army of servants, leaving the others to rescue Roxton after seduction becomes literal enslavement.

s02e13.description: Challenger is captured by children living in an isolated village protected by a gigantic carnivorous plant. The plant keeps enemies away only because the inhabitants feed it fresh meat, and the scientist is rapidly promoted from guest to provision.

s02e14.description: An intelligent underground people seize the explorers after attacks on Challenger's electrical equipment. Their leader needs Challenger's scientific help to adapt his species to life above ground, making cooperation both a possible escape and a biological experiment.

s02e15.description: Roxton and Marguerite discover an English-style village hidden beyond a narrow passage and immediately become entangled with a masked outlaw. A simple attempt to return stolen money ends with arrest, gunfire and the realization that local justice has its own agenda.

s02e16.description: Veronica and Malone are enslaved in a quarry and discover that the other workers are sophisticated machines. Their captors are extraterrestrials repairing a stranded spacecraft, and the pair must hide the inconvenient fact that they are not machines at all.

s02e17.description: An amulet found after a raid on the Treehouse leaves a dinosaur-shaped mark on those who touch it. The mark begins turning people into their animal counterparts, giving the expedition limited time to reverse a transformation that becomes less human by the hour.

s02e18.description: An ancient temple, living guardians and Marguerite's visions revive clues connected to Maple White and the original route to the Lost World. What looks like another escape opportunity forces the group to distinguish guidance from hallucination while surviving defenses that do not care.

s02e19.description: Marguerite ignores a warning attached to a pirate's treasure and brings the loot home. A journal leads Challenger and Malone toward an inland sea and descendants of the original pirates, where the old curse proves more practical than decorative.

s02e20.description: After Malone is mauled by a mysterious animal, Veronica discovers that her childhood friend Danu is connected to a werewolf outbreak. Malone begins showing the same symptoms, turning the search for Danu into a race against another transformation.

s02e21.description: A violent storm gives every member of the group visions of Summerlee, presumed lost at the waterfall. Malone follows the apparition alone, convinced it is leading him somewhere meaningful, while the others pursue him through a plateau still perfectly capable of killing the living.

s02e22.description: A British Navy dirigible appears over the plateau and seems to offer the escape the expedition has wanted for years. Malone disappears aboard it, Captain Askwith turns up with a suspicious account of events, and the damaged airship becomes the center of a dangerous cliffhanger.
